printf 'Dir::State::lists "/tmp/apt/lists";\nDir::Cache::archives "/tmp/apt/archives";\n' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99sendspin

mkdir -p /runtime/native /tmp/packages
cd /tmp/packages

for package in *.deb; do dpkg-deb --extract "$package" /runtime/native; done

python -m venv /runtime/venv

#!/bin/bash

set -o errexit
set -o nounset

if [[ -n "$HEALTHCHECKS_ID" ]]; then
    wget "https://hc-ping.com/$HEALTHCHECKS_ID/start" -T 10 -t 5 -O /dev/null
fi

cd /app

/app/transcode.sh -c
/app/transcode.sh -r

# Send completion ping to healthchecks
if [[ -n "$HEALTHCHECKS_ID" ]]; then
    wget "https://hc-ping.com/$HEALTHCHECKS_ID" -T 10 -t 5 -O /dev/null
fi

#!/bin/bash

set -o errexit
set -o nounset

if [[ -n "$HEALTHCHECKS_ID" ]]; then
    curl --silent --max-time 10 --retry 5 "https://hc-ping.com/$HEALTHCHECKS_ID/start"
fi

python /app/script.py \
    -H $HOST \
    -k $API_KEY \
    -o $BACKUP_LOCATION \
    --secret-seed --root-keys \
    --keep 90

# Send completion ping to healthchecks
if [[ -n "$HEALTHCHECKS_ID" ]]; then
    curl --silent --max-time 10 --retry 5  "https://hc-ping.com/$HEALTHCHECKS_ID"
fi

/hr/ghcr.io-bjw-s-labs-charts-immich-imm.doc:
Immich is a self-hosted photo and video backup solution.

For immich, there are multiple helm deployments:

  • immich-web
  • immich-server
  • immich-typesense
  • immich-machine-learning
  • immich-microservices (this one)

For redis and postgres, there are multiple helm charts:

  • Redis: app-template/redis, bitnami/redis
  • PostgreSQL: operator cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg, bitnami bitnami/postgresql

#!/bin/bash

set -o errexit
set -o nounset

curl --silent --location https://github.com/DavidMoore/ipfilter/releases/download/lists/ipfilter.dat.gz --output /tmp/ipfilter.dat.gz
gunzip /tmp/ipfilter.dat.gz
result=$(kubectl get pod --selector app.kubernetes.io/name=qbittorrent --output custom-columns=:metadata.name --namespace default)
QBITTORRENT_POD=$(echo $result | awk '{ print $NF }')
if [[ $QBITTORRENT_POD == *"qbittorrent"* ]]; then
  kubectl cp /tmp/ipfilter.dat default/$QBITTORRENT_POD:/config/ipfilter.dat
  kubectl rollout restart deployment qbittorrent --namespace default
else
  echo "qbittorrent deployment not found"
  exit 1
fi

while :; do
  for irq in $(ls /host/pcidev/msi_irqs); do
    cur=$(cat /host/proc/irq/$irq/smp_affinity_list)
    if [ "$cur" != "$CPU" ]; then
      echo "IRQ $irq on cpu $cur, moving to cpu $CPU"
      echo "$CPU" > /host/proc/irq/$irq/smp_affinity_list
    fi
  done
  sleep "$INTERVAL"
done
